results.title: Which singer is famous for Sufi music?
results.snippet: Abida Parveen (Sindhi: عابده پروين‎ ; Urdu: عابدہ پروین ; born 20 February 1954) is a Pakistani singer, composer, musician of Sufi music, painter and an entrepreneur. Often dubbed the Queen of Sufi music, Parveen is one of the highest-paid and most decorated vocalists in Pakistan.
